items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Teddy Reig was a daily visitor at my house at that point.

ctx.x: I was on a record date and we were coming up 7th Avenue and with, Teddy Reig was in the car, well, Teddy Reig was a daily visitor at my house at that point. And we came to a stop light and so he jumped out to get a Metronome mag, which was popular then, and he was reading a column about Mildred Bailey was going to have a radio show with Red Norvo and it mentioned my name.
